checks.explanation: Airtable has not conducted an IPO as of mid-2026, remaining a private company, so this prediction cannot yet be evaluated.

Congress did not eliminate the omnibus/continuing-resolution process; it continued to rely on CRs and omnibus packages through 2023-2026, so the hypothetical spending-reduction scenario was never actually tested.

Government shutdowns in this period (including a lengthy one in late 2025) did not durably end the CR process; Congress continued using continuing resolutions afterward, so the predicted savings scenario did not play out as described.

Long-term Treasury yields remained persistently elevated through 2023-2026 even as the Fed cut short-term rates in 2025, reflecting ongoing deficit concerns and keeping the broader cost of capital high.
FY2023 southern border encounters reached a new all-time annual record of roughly 3.2 million nationwide, surpassing the prior FY2022 high.

Biden did not run for reelection in 2024 (he withdrew in July 2024), so the border wall issue never became the deciding factor in his personal electoral fate as predicted; Harris lost the general election for other, broader reasons.
Waymo launched its robotaxi service to the public in Los Angeles in November 2024, matching the prediction of an LA launch following its San Francisco and Phoenix operations.

A roughly 10-year horizon (to around 2033) for full robotaxi deployment at scale is too far out to evaluate as of mid-2026, though expansion has been faster than some expected (LA, Austin, Atlanta, and more cities added by 2025).

Tesla continued to iterate its Full Self-Driving software through 2025-2026 with substantial improvements, but a fully credible Level 4/5 autonomous solution operating without supervision at scale had not been achieved by the predicted 2027-2028 window as of mid-2026.

Robotaxi expansion did prioritize dry, grid-friendly cities (Phoenix, LA, Austin, Atlanta) over harsher-weather regions, generally consistent with the prediction, though it is too early to confirm the Northeast is still more than a decade away.

No dozens of new Sphere-like venues have been built as of mid-2026; additional Sphere venues have been proposed (e.g., in Abu Dhabi) but construction of many such venues has not materialized at that scale yet.
Sphere Entertainment has explored smaller, lower-cost venue concepts and international expansion, but a wide global rollout comparable to IMAX theater proliferation had not occurred by mid-2026.
